title: Ruth 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: Elimelech and his sons die in the land of Moab.
Orpah stays behind, but Ruth goes with Naomi.

outline.text: Elimelech and his sons die in the land of Moab.

context: We find in this book excellent examples of faith, piety, patience, humility, industry, and loving-kindness, in the common events of life.
